lines.text: One day three years ago,
although we weren't expecting mothers or teenagers,
but to become a slightly better adult,
we agreed to Yoon's suggestion to quit smoking.
We decided to start to quit smoking.
What are we eating for lunch? Hurry and decide.
Whatever!
Why are you getting angry?! Why should we just eat whatever?!
Just hurry up and decide! Decide!
You think I'll be fast just because you asked me to be?
Are you trying to show off your lawyer airs in front of me?
Are you proud of not having good grades?
You had good grades, then why are you renting an office from me?
Then divorce!
What?!
Why are you bringing up the divorce?
You'll only earn money if he divorces.
Why are you suddenly picking on him?
Just pick whatever place.
If we're eating of course we should eat something that we want to eat!
I'm not eating!
Fine let's not eat.
Our separation from cigarettes made us like women who were placed under magic,
becoming sensitive and harsh.
So we each found something to release our emotions on.
Tae San chose to exercise.
What are you doing?
Did you just smoke?
Yoon chose snacking.
Jung Rok...
Honey, are you not sleepy? Let's just sleep!
What are you doing?
Just smoke the darn cigarette!
Chose something that underaged people are not allowed to watch.
I'm going to go crazy!
And I, I started to grow plants.
Although the process wasn't beautiful,
but in the end we all successfully quit smoking.
Episode 12
We meet again.
Do you live here?
Should I live here?
Hey you're a freshman in high school. That day in the club...
Which floor are you going to?
Seventh.
Same as me.
About going to the club, you've exceeded the time to file a case, so forget about it.
If you go to that sort of place again,
I now know where you live, so be careful, or else I'll tell your parents!
Bye.
Why are you following me?
I think it's here. My house.
Who is it?
Is someone supposed to come?
No.
Did someone order food?
No.
Hello.
Hello.
Hi!
Who are you..
I came to see all four of you.
Nice to meet you. I'm Kim Eun Hee's son.
You're Eun Hee's son?
You?
Kim Eun Hee?
Is it the Kim Eun Hee that we know?
Are you going to leave me standing outside?
Didn't you come to my office...
the cafe at the bottom floor of my office to meet with Me Ah Ri, that person?
Me Ah Ri?
Let's first let him in. He looks a lot like Eun Hee.
Come in.
Then, I'll see you around.
Come in.
You're pretty good looking.
What's your name?
You look like your mom.
I'm sorry.
An unexpected guest came.
Who is he?
I'll tell you later.
I'll call you.
The heels are really pretty.
Today's weather is nice, too.
Bye.
Are you really Eun Hee's son?
How old are you?
I was born in 95.
When we had the meeting, it was the DaeGu World Expo, so it should have been 93.
If you were born in 95 then...
Then at that time she abandoned us and left and then met your father?
I only heard her say that it was a very dramatic love.
Then what you said a while ago, what is it between you and Me Ah Ri?
We met on the plane from Japan.
Then your mom is in Japan now?
Yes.
Then why are you in Korea?
He left home, duh. Right?
I came to vacation.
If you were born in 95, then you should be a high schooler.
Why are you not in school? What vacation?
In Japan high school isn't mandatory.
Why are you so aggressive? Don't scare the kid.
But why did you come find us?
I spent all my money.
In Korea, this place where my heart and body don't have a place to stay.
That's why I would like to bother you guys for a few days.
Did Eun Hee ask you to come find us?
My mom doesn't know that I'm here.
But I hear her speak of you four often.
Who? Which out of us four?
Rok? Jung Rok?
Rok-sama? He was one of them, wasn't he?
Are you guys not tired?
You did the right thing. It's nice to meet you.
Just because you're Eun Hee's son, that one reason,
you are completely able to come depend on us.
Stay comfortably for a few days.
Let him stay in the hotel.
You're asking me to stay in a hotel?
Why? Do you need cash?
No, actually I...
want to stay in his house.
Because of my mom,
I saw a picture of you four and she mentioned you the most.
Get up, let's go.
Why did she have to mention me in front of the kid?
It's Lee Jung Rok. Did you hear wrong?
Hey, didn't he say that it was me? It's me.
What?!
A train headed towards Chunchun?
There wasn't a boat?
How can you let the kid stay in a hotel?
You're tired, aren't you?
Let's go, let's go home and rest.
Yeah, bye. See you again!
Why are you not leaving?
Hey! Right now my body and mind need a place to stay too, okay?
Kim Eun Hee?
Yeah, Kim Eun Hee. Do you know her?
Is it the writer of the drama Phantom?
Soganji!
Not her.
In the group of people around you, is there someone with that name?
It's not the oppas' first love is it?
Oppas' first loves?
They met for the first time in a meeting during college.
The four of them seemed to have been completely mesmerized by her.
And then one day she suddenly left without saying and went to the US.
Left?
Yeah.
That's why all four of them can't forget her.
I should learn that move.
They all say that she liked themselves more.
If you just mention this name, the four of them will argue.
It's really childish.
Is that so.
That's right, Teach.
I'm sorry for acting like a child last time.
I'm sincerely rooting for you and Do Jin.
I think it's her, that woman.
Which woman?
Kim Eun Hee, the four guys' first love.
That woman's son appeared.
Her son appeared?
We're going to order take out. Are you going to eat here?
No, I'm going to leave soon.
All right.
Didn't you say you had a date tonight?
You even left all dressed up like that.
Why did you not even eat and came back?
That,
have you ever heard Tae San talk about his first love before?
Why, is a secret love not enough? I even have to know about his first love?
Why?
Did Im Tae San meet his first love?
No,
I heard that the first love for the four of them is the same woman.
I wanted to ask if you knew.
What is this now?
Four men's first loves, how can they all be with the same woman?
That person's probably drop dead gorgeous.
Mom
Who is it?
My mom.
Is she doing well?
Be careful going home. I won't walk you out.
What's wrong with my Teach?
Is her relationship with her mom bad?
So what if it is?
Can I not just ask?
How's your brother doing lately?
The same. Why?
Can I not just ask? Be careful going home.
Damn my curiosity.
Mom: let's talk over the phone
Just treat this as your home.
You can read those books.
If you go to the second floor,...
Can you not come home earlier?
I was with Teacher Yi Soo..
What's going on?
Why are you here?
I heard that you guys have met before.
It's my friend's son.
He's here vacationing, so he'll be staying with us for a few days.
Then he's your first love's son?
How did you know?
Let me formally introduce myself, Noona.
Formally my butt.
We've eaten together several times already.
Also, before you refused to speak formally.
What's going on?
You called me "Noona"?
Oppa, he's so weird.
You girl, he's a guest.
Our Me Ah Ri isn't like me, her personality isn't that soft.
She's like our maternal grandma.
Anyway, the days that you're living here, treat it as your own home.
Be comfortable.
But no matter what, Noona's around.
I should still be mindful.
Indeed,
Eun Hee's very good at teaching her kids.
That's right, you can use that room.
Then it's very nice to meet you, Noona.
He really has a split personality.
Where were you?
Yi Soo's house?
What is it that you want to know?
Se Ra even asked how you were doing.
And then?
What'd you say?
I'm not going to tell you?
Did she not ask anything else?
Was that all she asked?
I don't know.
At your age, you could have already married twice.
If I were choosing someone to marry, I wouldn't choose you either.
Unnie, if you keep hitting like that you're going to kill your shoulder.
Do what you need to do.
Don't speak to me until I speak to you.
I just coincidentally wanted to practice golf here.
If you have that much strength then why didn't you go play baseball?
What are you doing playing golf?
Baseball players have longer lives, don't they?
Can you stop using that mouth of yours?
No matter what I'm your senior.
Have you taken care of me before?
And what, you say you're my senior?
What did you just say?
True, so what if my competition scores are good?
The money you earn is a lot more than me.
You've filmed CFs, posters, you even played golf with the boss.
Wonder whether or not you slept with them.
How much is it for one night?
Hey.
Did you just hit me?
Yeah, I did.
Say that again.
I'm asking you, did you just hit me?
Say that again!
You really!
Just because you're younger than me you want to use your brute strength?
People who graduate from a sports college are always being called stupid because of you,
you know?
You're going to die today.
Let go.
Is this a war between the old and new golf goddess?
It's pretty interesting.
Are you not going to let go?!
Who are you?
Are you curious as to who I am?
You'll find out soon.
Owner Kim! Owner Kim, where are you?!
Is this how you manage your golf field?
There are quite a few familiar faces.
Do you all plan on continuing to watch the fun?
Your eyeball is bruised.
Your cornea is also bleeding a little.
Wear the eye patch for a week and take your prescription.
Avoid vigorous exercise.
Your head can't be shaken too much either.
Then what about tears?
What?
Nothing.
Why did you help me?
Should I help someone that I don't know?
If you're busy, then you can leave.
It's my alarm. It's time for me to eat my medicine.
Get home by yourself.
We're not the type to send each other home anyway.
Your prescription's out.
Thank you.
What? They're almost all done.
Why is she not eating her own medicine?
That's right!
Have a pack on an empty stomach.
What are you doing in someone's house?
You're really...
get out.
I'll get out.
I came to get my clothes.
Even when you're outside, you don't forget to take care of your body.
I saw that there weren't many packs left.
You're working so hard on finishing them,
do you even know what sort of medicine it is?
It's good for the body. It's medicine.
So you just came for the medicine because you're afraid of ruining your body?
Of course, of course I have to work hard and eat them all.
If I work hard on finishing them then we can have a kid.
What?
Isn't this medicine for conceiving a baby?
That's why I work so hard to eat it.
I saw that you haven't had many packs.
Should I open one for you?
Are you not leaving?
So I still have to leave?
All right then.
This is the back of someone who knows when he should leave.
Watch carefully.
Sorry for being late.
Nice to meet you.
My name is Eun Hee, Kim Eun Hee.
She was really pretty.
Weren't you thinking of Eun Hee?
The person who was about to die because of Eun Hee,
including you, I sure did save a lot of people.
The one who said he wanted to commit suicide and went to the Han River the most was you.
It's in the past. Really.
But I still feel miffed.
All four of us liked her so much.
Then suddenly she cut off all communication and disappeared.
What kind of man did she get married with?
I know.
What about him? How is he?
Eun Hee's son?
He's doing well.
It's like he's at his own home.
But what if he really left home?
If you leave home would you stay in your mom's friend's house?
Maybe because he's the same as Eun Hee, he just showed up.
But shouldn't we get in contact with Eun Hee?
I think a few years ago she was still contacting Jung Rok.
Didn't we make a complete revolution on that jerk's cell phone with our own hands?
That's right.
Anyway, time flies.
Eun Hee's already a mom.
If you're envious then have a kid.
Having a baby isn't something I can do alone.
The woman doesn't even want to marry.
I'm going to the site. I'm feeling depressed.
This weekend I'll go alone to the Chunchun site.
Really? For real, right? For real!
Bye!
She should be really curious. She's enduring quite well.
I clearly said that...
It's a gift.
I gave you this for you to copy.
How did it become a gift?
That's a new book. Your copy, I'm keeping it.
But you still have to copy it.
I'll just read it.
I can't believe you.
What about your money from your job? Has it wired to your account?
More so than money, shouldn't you first worry about my body?
You made your body become like that to earn money.
Of course I should worry about the money first.
It wired. So I'm giving you a gift.
Thanks.
Then starting from now on,
you need to start thinking about what you promised me before.
You have to do something for me.
A lover.
Your wounds must be minor.
Do I have to break your other arm for you to wake up?
I have a boyfriend.
Did you not hear the rumors?
I'll think about it.
Yeah. I'll watch over you as a guardian.
Fine.
You can't sleep, right?
I've already come without telling you,
so don't be too touchy and hurry and come out.
I'm in front of your house.
How come you didn't even call?
The text that your cell phone just received, who sent it?
I was talking about the whole day.
Did you think about me?
You're hurt because I didn't call.
You feel anxious.
Were you complaining about me inside?
Of course I did.
You should have also realized your own stubbornness.
Definitely a lot.
But even so, you never thought about contacting me first?
Are you taking out revenge on me right now?
Normally,
shouldn't the person who shooed the other away be the first to contact said person?
Should we take a walk?
If you don't want to then we can go on a vacation.
Really.
You must be curious about who Eun Hee is.
Of course I am.
Because all four of you guys had a stunned expression at the time.
Because she's the person who received our love and almost made our friendship crack.
Is she really your first love?
What person has their first love in their twenties?
When you're 12, it's called first love.
True, who am I talking to.
Twenty years ago, I liked someone.
Sincerely.
That kid from yesterday is her son.
I know all of this.
That's all of it.
No way.
What do you want to know?
Have you still not forgotten her?
How could I forget her?
I just don't think of it everyday.
Before when I started my own company,
the friends that betrayed me and the company's employees,
my high school counselor,
the owner of the shop where I visited often and kept an open tab with in college,
the weather the day that Betty came,
I remember all of it.
Even the woman whose dress got caught on my bag,
and caused the bottom of her dress to disappear is the same.
Twenty years later,
even if you aren't by my side, I'll still remember everything.
That's true, the way you put it.
What? Your jealousy ends halfway?
I even crashed my car.
What use is it to be jealous?
A first love in a man's memory, how can I compete with that?
I can just think of a way for that memory to not surface as many times.
Who can help that out of all the people that you can't forget, only I am in the current.
Then how about you try to be in my future?
One minute into the future?
That amount of time I can guarantee.
Rejecting someone despite welcoming it isn't in the one-sided love booklet.
My ambition is different than most people.
Where is that kid right now?
In Tae San's house.
Tae San's house?
He wanted to go there.
Perhaps the person that Eun Hee really liked was Tae San.
Back in the day I really didn't see him as an enemy.
Exactly. He's very charismatic to the ladies...
What was that, just now?
A little sign.
If you're caught by me, I'm not going to let you off easily!
Leave.
What if you're seen by Se Ra when she wakes up in a bit?
Who told you to kiss me? You're really brash.
Can you feel my bad thoughts?
I'm dispersing my desires.
I have to continue until I have no strength left.
Then, I'll become bald.
Then I'll leave you.
Don't.
Even if you have a belly, I'll still like you.
Let me see you from the side.
What are you doing?
What if Se Ra wakes up?
As long as you're quiet she won't wake up.
Hurry!
Hurry what? Like this?
Hurry and get up! Hurry!
To go on vacation?
Really!
Hurry and sleep!
I already said that I'd leave after you fall asleep.
Why is your heart beating so fast?
It's not my heart.
Doesn't matter whose it is.
It seems like it's mine too.
I like how you don't pretend to be cool.
Did you never think that I may be pretending to be naive?
I like that, too.
I have a favor to ask.
Before I come to stop liking you,
don't not like me.
All right.
Really?
Why are women always so unbelieving?
Because men usually will say that yesterday that was so,
but today it isn't.
But both of them are sincere.
That's the problem.
Then today it's so and tomorrow it will be too.
The day after tomorrow and the day after that.
For the next month it will be.
So at least for this month, you can feel at ease.
Do I have to say it that way?
It's a little better.
I got it.
Then within this month, I will love Seo Yi Soo.
What happens afterwards, I'll let you know in a month.
Then, I'm a month of your future.
Leave, I'm sleepy.
I'm really sensitive, so if someone besides me makes any noise...
Sleep, sleep, sleep...
Sensitive?
You can sleep when I'm by your side?
My San
Hello?
Where are you?
What is it?
Let's meet up.
I can't lately. I have some things to do.
What things?
It's not Hong Se Ra's style to use this sort of excuse to avoid me.
That's right.
If I hate you, then I hate you.
Why would I avoid you?
How scary is that.
If you think I'm lying, then just assume that.
What's up with you?
Why did you come out from there?
I'm dating one of the people in this house. Did you forget that fast?
Why're you here?
I'm having a cold war with a person in this house.
The women in this house sure aren't easy to deal with.
Is it a problem with the design?
It should be a problem with its construction.
You're really treating this place as your own house.
Your brother told me to.
Didn't you say you would use formal language?
Not like your brother's here.
What should I do with this brat? What should I do?
Be honest, what relationship do you have with those oppas?
What is your goal of getting close to us?
Who talked to me first on the plane?
And who was it who got stuck in a bathroom at the bar first?
You didn't plan all of that, did you?
You seem to think that you're the president's daughter.
My blood pressure.
Don't get too worked up. You'll develop feelings.
Jerks like you exist.
My oppa
Why did he call? Why?
Hel...lo?
That's amusing.
It's me. Are you at home?
Yes, why?
Is that guy next to you?
If he is let him talk on the phone.
I don't know his phone number.
Did you call just for that?
Here.
Me?
Hello?
We seem to have some things to talk about.
Let's meet.
Fine. Where are you?
I'll go over.
No, I can come over.
I'm nearby.
Okay.
Oppa.
Didn't you say you were nearby?
It took a long time.
I had an appointment with someone and was delayed a bit.
Let's talk in Tae San's room for a while.
What kind of tea do you want?
No need.
You don't need to listen. Just stay here.
Let's go up.
The words you said last time when you came looking for me in my office...
In Korea, do lawyers still do personal consultations?
Answer my question.
Im Me Ah Ri. Go downstairs.
Not long ago, you found out the relationship between your real father and us.
You seem to have really liked my mom.
Let me see your passport.
That counts as invading my privacy, doesn't it?
Are you really born in '95?
Are you my dad?
I didn't come here to crack jokes with you.
Don't change the subject and answer me.
I'll tell you when I need money.
Before then,
secrets that you find out through your work, you must not reveal either.
Isn't that Law #317?
I think that's what they said.
How long do you plan on staying in Korea?
That depends on you guys.
I'm just from the perspective of causing you guys trouble.
Ask Me Ah Ri for my contact information.
If you have anything to say, then contact me immediately.
Are you going to stay at home all day today?
If nothing comes up, probably.
You finished talking already?
What time are you going to work?
I planned on going after eating lunch.
Today's traffic is really bad. You should leave earlier.
Anyway it's on the way, I'll take...
I pass this road everyday,
but how come today it feels like it's a fairytale?
The words that I said, did you think about them?
I was just thinking why haven't you brought it up yet.
Of course I thought about it, because everyday I think about you.
Then you reached a conclusion, too.
Of course.
So you have that kind of expression when you say mean things.
To hurt me you used that special tone of voice to speak to me.
What I meant was...
I know.
To summarize what you said,
"don't cause trouble and get lost".
That's why I thought about it.
If you hurt someone then you will always think of them.
Then if I want someone to not forget me, I have to let that person continue to hurt me.
Kiddo, that wasn't the point of what I said.
Do you think I don't understand the point?
Am I too young or is my history too clean?
And you're not as cute as Do Jin.
Where do you get that confidence?
Am I blind?
An ahjusshi like that, why is he worth me liking him?
I'm speechless.
We're here. Stop the car please.
How is it?
You're hurt, aren't you?
Will you always think of Me Ah Ri then?
Have a good day, old man.
Hey, why'd you follow me?
Hey.
How is it?
Are you used to staying in Tae San's house?
I'm not picky about housing.
I'm like that too.
I can sleep well anywhere.
I'm staying in Do Jin's place now too.
Anyway, in the house, isn't there a woman who's really short?
If she says anything to you, tell me.
Although I can't give her a shot, I can argue back with you.
What?
But the person that your mom mentions the most, is it really Tae San?
It's not me? Think carefully.
I only had one address, and that was yours.
I'm not the sort of man who's unforgettable.
What's your mom's number?
I don't want to tell you.
You're the exact same as your mom.
But your mom will worry about you, hurry.
If it's for my mom's phone number, then let's not meet anymore.
Thanks for the drink.
Hey, hey! Are you going to leave just like that?
Where did it go? I specifically put it here.
I don't think oppas are in contact with his mom.
The kid is just being thick-skinned.
Nice to meet you. I'm Kim Eun Hee's son.
Do you have time?
What's wrong with your eye?
It's an emergency! It's Tae San. Say that I'm not home.
Hong Se Ra! Come out for a moment!
Hurry!
Hong Se Ra! I said come out for a moment!
I told him that I wasn't home.
Just say any lie.
I know that you're inside.
I saw your car and I saw the light on in your room.
I just saw you come home.
Come out for a moment. I'll wait for you.
I'll go out for a bit.
When did she become like that?
What is that, in the middle of the night?
Did you get plastic surgery?
After women have plastic surgery done they'll wear sunglasses.
If they become like this if they'll wear them, too.
Who did that? Which jerk did that?
Everything about you,
from your head to your toes, is still mine.
No matter whether it's five minutes or five seconds.
I fought with a junior.
Open the door.
Even if we break up we have to go somewhere else.
Yi Soo's home.
I thought about it these past few days, seriously.
I wasn't rash and thought about it with reason,
so don't misunderstand.
If what you want is to marry,
then let's break up.
I told you that I can take care of you.
Let you play golf for the rest of your life and enjoy life.
Is marrying that hard?
Although golf has let me live,
I don't play golf just for my own survival.
Don't change the subject.
Let me ask you one last time. Reply carefully.
Do you not want to marry me?
I'm sorry.
Are women all like this?
Or is it just you who makes people feel confused.
I worked my butt off to get to the place where I am today.
I don't want to retire like I was squeezed out by competition...
after having worked so hard to climb to where I am now.
Who told you to retire?
Does a professional golfer's career end when she marries?
I'm the one who doesn't have confidence.
I only have that much skill.
What's the best thing that should I do?
What should I do?
Are we really over?
This time I won't come back to your side.
I never will again. You know me.
I'm going home.
What's going on today? Why are you so happy?
I'm going to the construction site.
You're so happy even though you're going to work?
The site's in Chunchun.
First I can get away from Seoul.
An unfamiliar and long night.
In an unfamiliar place, the night makes one feel restless.
Are you not coming back home tonight?
I don't want to come back home tomorrow either.
He's sure happy.
Hello Betty.
What did you just do?
Why?
You suddenly treat her so well.
Even if I break up with you, I'll still keep in touch with Betty.
Are you saying that you're going to hold her hostage?
Then I'll have to form a good relationship with your house, too.
Where are we going?
You'll know after we're there.
Where are we going?
On a vacation.
What'd you say?
If you don't like vacations, think of it as accompanying me temporarily on a vacation.
Why didn't you tell me?
I already said many times for us to go on a vacation together.
I didn't say "okay" yet.
So? Where are we going now?
Chunchun!
Chunchun?
It's a one day trip right?
Do I seem to be like that sort of person?
Betty, stop!
Betty, fighting! Go on the highway.
Kim Do Jin!
Over there is land for the hotel management university that will be built.
You're even planning on building a school?
Seems like I'll have to continue showing good work.
After the Quartz Resort is built, over there we'll build a school.
You can also work here directly.
Education will become management's fertile ground.
We've reached a consensus with Switzerland's top hotel management university.
I've been really happy lately.
We're also finishing up the Sam Sung Dong's promotion gallery.
Then I'll see you the day of the gallery opening ceremony.
Our Quartz Resort doesn't need anything else.
It's suitable for playing, well designed, it's safe, I just need those three things.
Just those three things, then you mean you want all of them.
That's why I'm being worked to death.
Is that so?
Anyway, we'll do our best to build the most unique amusement park in the world.
Okay.
The whole world's most unique amusement theme park that covers 198584 sq. ft,
have you seen it before?
A resort and a villa.
You can swim and ski at the same time.
Are you boasting about your past?
I've never seen it either.
